title: Definition of period
text: A function has period $$w$$ if $$p\left(x+kw\right)=p(x)$$ for all $$x, $$ where $$k$$ is an integer.

title: Multiple periods
text: $$\cos(\theta)$$ is $$2\pi$$ periodic, because you return to the original position on the circle when you have traveled $$2\pi$$ radians. But you also travel back to the same position after $$4\pi$$ or $$6\pi$$ or $$100\pi$$.

title: Not a period
text: $$\cos(\theta)$$ is not $$3\pi$$ periodic. For example, $$\cos(0)=1$$ but $$\cos(3\pi)=-1$$.
